content_metadata.title: Speech by President António Costa at the 47th colloquium on international relations at the University of Minho
content_metadata.summary: In his speech, President António Costa discusses the challenges facing international relations today, emphasizing the importance of a rules-based international order, the need for global partnerships, and the European Union's role in promoting peace, prosperity, and stability. He highlights the significance of international law and cooperation in addressing global challenges.
